capabilities: Track countdowns, birthdays, and anniversaries in a sorted list view
Create and edit events as markdown notes with frontmatter
Repeat events daily, weekly, yearly, or on custom intervals with solar and lunar calendar rules
Embed event rows in any note with a countdown code block
Fire reminders days before an occurrence via system notifications or notices
extras: Not yet listed in the community marketplace; manual installation from GitHub releases is required. UI is bilingual (English / 简体中文).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in view for tracking recurring personal dates like birthdays and anniversaries, especially on the lunar calendar.
summary: Countdown tracker that lists countdowns, birthdays, and anniversaries in a dedicated view, with solar and lunar calendar support and event data stored in notes.
